validated_commands.note: mix not available in CI runner; tests validated by CI on merge. CI runs on PRs via .github/workflows/ci.yml (trigger: pull_request to **). CI stack: Elixir 1.20.0-rc.5 + OTP 28.5.

testing_notes.framework: ExUnit with DataCase (async: true), Factory via ex_machina
testing_notes.coverage_tool: excoveralls (mix coveralls.html); CI does not block on coverage thresholds
testing_notes.mix_unavailable: mix binary not in PATH in CI runner
testing_notes.mapper_test_pattern: Use ExUnit.Case async:true with struct!() helper + override map
testing_notes.struct_helper_pattern: Use struct!(ModuleName, Map.merge(defaults, overrides)) NOT Map.merge on a struct
testing_notes.query_builder_test_pattern: Inspect query.from.source, length(query.wheres), length(query.order_bys). No DB needed.
testing_notes.nil_guard_test_pattern: Use length(query.wheres) == 0 for no-op guard tests
testing_notes.enrollment_policy_queries_note: EnrollmentPolicyQueries tested with real DB (DataCase async:true); 14 tests
testing_notes.invite_field_validations_note: InviteFieldValidations tested via embedded_schema in ExUnit.Case async:true; 18 tests (PR #719 merged 2026-05-10)
testing_notes.global_publisher_race_705: Issue #705: :participation_seed_roster_subscriber causes race; Mox fix recommended
testing_notes.accounts_command_test_pattern: RegisterUser/AnonymizeUser/ChangeEmail: DataCase async:true, AccountsFixtures, real UserRepository, no event assertions needed
testing_notes.incident_report_mapper_note: IncidentReportMapper: provider_profile_id (domain) <-> provider_id (DB); maybe_to_string nil-guard for program_id/session_id
testing_notes.domain_event_test_pattern: EventDispatchHelper.dispatch/2 uses DomainEventBus (not TestEventPublisher port). Bridge via DomainEventBus.subscribe. Use async:false.
testing_notes.coverage_saturation_note: As of 2026-06-03, backlog largely exhausted. Remaining: #705 (global config mutation refactor) and #515 (E2E scale) require maintainer decisions. No new code introduced since 2026-06-02.
testing_notes.pr_944_sweep_note: Maintainer merged all 11 TI PRs via #944 (2026-06-02), sweeping to ExUnit standard with stream_data properties. LoginByMagicLink now uses async:true.
testing_notes.refactor_937_notes: Big refactor #937 introduced: CommandResult, Domain.Validation, CursorCodec, MapperHelpers.maybe_to_string/from_persistence!, PersistenceSupport macro, ParticipationLiveHandlers, MessagingLiveHelper. First four now have TI tests (PR #945).
testing_notes.from_persistence_bang_test_note: MapperHelpers.from_persistence!/3 test: define inline defmodule with unique names (MapperHelpersTestSuccessModel/FailModel) inside describe block to avoid atom collisions.
testing_notes.cursor_codec_test_note: CursorCodec is pure, no DB needed. encode returns URL-safe base64 (no +/=). decode(nil) -> {:ok, nil}. All error paths return {:error, :invalid_cursor}.
testing_notes.command_result_wrap_note: CommandResult.wrap_validation_errors/1: only wraps {:error, list}; all other shapes pass through unchanged.
testing_notes.projection_test_async_note: Projection tests (adapters/driven/projections/) use async:false; macro-level projection tests (projection_test.exs) use async:true with Agent fakes. Documented in .claude/rules/testing.md (added #927).
testing_notes.untested_trivial_note: Remaining untested lib files are mostly ports (behaviours only), pass-through query modules, trivial structs (active?/1 etc.), Mailer, Release, context facades. None have logic worth unit testing.

maintainer_priorities: Maintainer merged all 11 TI PRs via #944 sweep (2026-06-02). This confirms high engagement and quality focus — maintainer added stream_data property tests on top of the example-based tests.
